ABOUT
BUFFALO ROCK
Buffalo Rock Tented Camp is perfectly located in a private and secluded part of the Nkambeni Private Concession, within the borders of the world-renowned Kruger National Park. Offering visitors the opportunity to commune with nature in a pristine and unspoilt wildlife-rich wilderness, Buffalo Rock Tented Camp is completely unfenced and regularly welcomes roaming wildlife, including members of the Big Five. Although the Camp is called Buffalo Rock, Lion and Leopard are regularly spotted sunning themselves on the rocky outcrop close to the camp.
To further enhance your safari experience at Buffalo Rock you will enjoy authentic under-canvas accommodation, reminiscent of the early pioneer days of wildlife safaris in Africa. In order to leave the smallest possible foot-print in this pristine wilderness, Buffalo Rock Tented Camp is purely powered by solar energy, making this camp an ideal choice for eco-warriors.
The camp conducts regular daily game drives within the traversing area of the concession as well as inside the unfenced borders of the Kruger National Park. Come and experience the thrill of luxury camping surrounded by nature at its finest, here at Buffalo Rock Tented Camp.

Verified Buffalo Rock - a great location for a Kruger NP safari We loved our stay at Buffalo Rock. The staff were friendly & supportive. We loved the little touches such as hot/cold towels upon arrival back from game drives. The drives were all great, although some were better than others depending on the guide for that day. However, they all tried their hardest to find the animals we hoped to see. The tent was good, the beds were comfortable. The tents themselves are pretty basic, but up there with standard Glamping. The main issues we had were the shower not working in our tent, running freezing cold even when the management tried to fix it for us, and on occasion the food was a little on the cold side. It was good, tasty food, though not a huge variety of choice. We had no complaints. The game drives were 6 hours every morning and 3 hours every afternoon. So whilst the camp itself was basic to some level, the whole experience overall was great. I was a little disappointed not to see or hear any wildlife in or around the camp, but that's the beauty of wild animals, they choose when they visit. The sightings on the drives were, however, fantastic.
Posted on Tripadvisor

Verified Fantastic 5-star experience! My mom and I stayed at Buffalo Rock for 2 nights in July. What a fantastic experience! We visit Kruger Park at least once a year, and this was one of the best experiences we have had. All of the staff and our guides were incredible. The accommodation is very comfortable and we thoroughly enjoyed the semi-outdoor shower. We were given so much delicious food that we thought we might never eat again :) The train that runs nearby can be a bit noisy, but it should definitely not put anyone off from staying here. We were treated like royalty and had every need catered to. We also had amazing sightings and thoroughly enjoyed our sunrise drinks at stunning locations. We will definitely be staying here again!

Everyone there was just so friendly and incredibly accommodating from start to finish. A huge thanks to our driver, Israel (aka Chef)! He is so knowledgeable and clearly very experienced. He tried so hard for us to see all the different animals and really went above and beyond. Highly recommend this place if you want a great safari experience with awesome people!

Accommodation - Buffalo Rock
Skip to content

LUXURY TENTED
ACCOMMODATION
Bedtime could be your favourite time of the day at Buffalo Rock Safari Camp as you drift off to sleep with just a thin layer of canvas between you and the wonderful sounds of the African bushveld. The mornings are equally thrilling as you awaken to the dawn chorus of birds, welcoming you to another beautiful sunrise and a perfect day in Africa.
The camp has just 12 privately-situated tented suites, each of which has an outdoor seating area overlooking the wilderness and the rocky outcrop for which the camp is named. Each of the permanent “tents” has been constructed on a solid wooden deck and has its own en-suite shower room with toilet and basin. Your canvas “walls” feature large picture windows which allow in plenty of light and offer views of the bush.
Each tent has very comfortable extra-length twin beds and quality linen and duvets, offering a true “out of Africa” ambiance. Indoor/outdoor bathrooms allow you the rare privilege of taking a private shower with a view out over the wilderness.
Each room has wifi, power outlets for cell-phones or tablets, and a fan.

OFF THE GRID
OUR STATE OF THE ART SOLAR SYSTEM
Buffalo Rock has embraced eco-friendly innovation with its state-of-the-art Off Grid Solar System. This system includes a 15.6 kWp Solar Photovoltaic (PV) array and a 57 kWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), ensuring a reliable and environmentally-friendly power source for all our tents and main areas.
With our solar energy solution, we re not only reducing our environmental impact but also setting a new benchmark in eco-conscious luxury. Experience the beauty of nature while enjoying the modern comfort of sustainable energy at Buffalo Rock.
